name: Sylan
description: Sylan, a half-elf rogue, presents the council with evidence that Gerk is the child sought by the Navi, drawing on an old journal and a spiritual vision he experienced in Jotunheim. He notes that the journal does not explicitly state the prophecy, but that it accurately described the conspiracy that killed his family. When Plymouth offers the party keystones, Sylan accepts stewardship of the Keystone of Gilbrick, having been given first choice because of his connection to that realm. In his audience with the Raven Queen, he declines any further favor or boon, believing she has already done enough for him. She identifies him as a talon of her order rather than a butcher, reminds him to value his life instead of expecting or preparing for death, and gives him final instruction regarding his role and responsibilities.
